name: ShadowClaw Agent CLI Weather
description: Headless CLI weather station, forecasting, and environmental advisory powered by ShadowClaw

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: Fetch current and hourly air quality data for Chicago, Illinois (or specified coordinates) using the Open-Meteo Air Quality API. Returns UV index, European AQI, PM2.5, PM10, and particulate levels.

tools.name: get_current_weather
tools.description: Fetch real-time weather conditions for Chicago, Illinois (or specified coordinates) using the Open-Meteo API. Returns temperature, apparent temperature, humidity, wind speed/direction/gusts, precipitation, cloud cover, and WMO weather code.

tools.name: get_weather_forecast
tools.description: Fetch a multi-day weather forecast for Chicago, Illinois (or specified coordinates) using the Open-Meteo API. Returns daily high/low temperatures, precipitation, wind, sunrise/sunset, and WMO weather codes. Hourly data includes temperature, dew point, apparent temperature, humidity, precipitation probability, wind speed, and weather code — suitable for condition-window queries such as 'find the next 24h where temp > 2C and temp is 3C above dew point'.

tools.name: lookup_location_coords
tools.description: Look up geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude) for a given location name using the Open-Meteo Geocoding API. Useful before calling weather endpoints for a non-default location.
